name: Wahoo's Fish Taco
notes: First-party white-label ordering system for this exact address (1006 N El Camino Real confirmed in the page JSON). Prices embedded in escaped JSON as literal '$$X.XX' (doubled dollar sign, an escaping artifact of the page's JS template-literal payload) -- normalized to single '$'. Dropped section/category header objects whose 'name' field (Most Ordered, Entrees, Salads/Soup, Burritos, Desserts, Drinks, Just for kids, Shared Plates, Online Sides, Tacos & Enchiladas, BOWL, Chips and Salsa) matched a nearby child item's price rather than being a real dish, and dropped one 'Wahoo's Fish Taco' row that was the store name, not a dish. Cent distribution mixed and conventional (.00/.25/.50/.75/.95/.65/.40/.10/.45/.30/.85 etc), no uniform-markup signature; no divisor sweep applied. 61 dishes filed.

name: Ryan Bros Coffee of San Marcos
notes: First-party Spot ordering widget embedded on ryanbroscoffee.com's homepage, whose banner headline names 'Ryan Bros Coffee - San Marcos -- 133 N Twin Oaks Valley Rd Ste110, San Marcos, CA 92069' (exact batch address) as the page's primary location; the widget's spot_id (30938) is the single sitewide ordering config, so the branch tie is inferred from that banner rather than an explicit location field in the menu payload itself -- hence medium not high. Ryan Bros is a small multi-location local chain (also Barrio Logan, City Heights, Rancho Bernardo, Navy Base Pacific Beacon, Downtown); this page is the only one confirmed tied to the San Marcos address. Deduped exact-duplicate cards (Avocado Toast, Acai Bowl, Hot Nitro Draft each appeared twice identically). 58 dishes (drinks + food) filed across Food / Hot & Cold Coffee Drinks / Smoothies & Specialty.

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Bitter Blond
dishes.description: A lighter, more aromatic alternative to traditional dark bitters. With pleasant hints of citrus, combined with a bold bitter flavor, this classic Italian drink is perfect to drink on its own as an aperitif, or to mix for more complex drinks.

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Bitter Red
dishes.description: This traditional Italian bitter, presents a complex flavor profile of rich citrus, combined with rhubarb and gentian, creating for a distinctly bitter flavor. Iconic as an aperitif, or as a base in cocktails such as negroni.

dishes.name: Sanpellegrino Pompelmo
dishes.description:
Italian creativity and craftsmanship come together in this unique, thirst-quenching grapefruit drink. A soothing yellow in color, like the early morning glow over the endless rows of citrus trees, it opens with the fresh bouquet of juicy grapefruit, a prelude to its dramatic flavor experience.

One sip reveals a full flavor profile that is carried through the pleasant fizz of its fine bubbles, presenting the perfect balance of sweet and bitter. The delicious notes of squeezed grapefruit travel across your entire palate, lingering with a softness you will never forget.

dishes.name: Sanpellegrino Aranciata Rossa
dishes.description:
This authentic premium drink is made from a unique blend of sun-ripened oranges and blood oranges from Italy. Each can or bottle captures the bright, intense aroma of oranges that pop through its fine bubbles, in a rose tinted drink that takes its color from the juices of genuine ingredients from natural origins.

Refined, refreshing Sanpellegrino Aranciata Rossa is a medium bodied drink with a delicate sweetness that persists sip after sip, allowing you fully savor the complex flavor of quality Italian oranges and blood oranges.

dishes.name: Sanpellegrino Limonata
dishes.description:
Its soft yellow colour with bright green undertones is just like the perfectly ripe lemon glowing under the sun in the lemon grove. Open the bottle and its bold personality is immediately apparent thanks to the intense bouquet of lemons that fills the air.

Refreshingly dry with a bright lemon flavor, delicate citrus notes linger on the palate sip after sip. Sanpellegrino Limonata is the premium lemon drink with only the best of Italian lemons to give you the authentic Italian drinking experience.

dishes.name: A' Siciliana Limonata
dishes.description: A'Siciliana Lemon Soda is crafted from fresh lemons harvested along the scenic coasts of Sicily. Popular throughout Italy, this soda offers a refreshing taste that will transport you to citrus groves and the cool Mediterranean breeze. Enjoy a "Limonata" with the perfect balance of sweet, tart, and zesty flavors. Serve it over ice with a sprig of fresh mint or use it to create delightful cocktails.

dishes.name: A' Siciliana Aranciata
dishes.description:
Lightly carbonated and lightly sweetened fruit drinks made with freshly squeezed Arancia Rossa di Sicilia blood oranges harvested along the Sicilian coast. Blood oranges have a unique, distinct raspberry flavor in addition to citrus notes.

The climate of Sicily is perfect for the cultivation of citrus because these fruits love to bask in the Mediterranean's sunny days and breezy nights. And when the climate of Sicily is matched with the rich volcanic soil surrounding Mt. Etna, the result is a deliciously refreshing sparkling beverage.

Packaged in cans and bottles with iconic artwork reminiscent of "la dolce vita" era, every sip of A' Siciliana is the very essence of the sweet life.

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Negroni Soda
dishes.description:
A Taste of Italy in Every Sip
Experience the classic flavors of Italy with La Dolce Vita Negroni Soda. Imported directly from Italy, this sophisticated beverage captures the essence of the iconic Negroni cocktail in a refreshing, non-alcoholic soda.

Refreshingly Bubbly and Balanced
Each 11oz can is perfectly carbonated, delivering a crisp and bubbly experience with every sip. Whether you're relaxing at home or entertaining guests, this soda offers a delightful and sophisticated alternative to traditional beverages.

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Coffee Soda
dishes.description: LA DOLCE VITA Coffee Soda: Delight in the unexpected fusion of bold Italian coffee and refreshing bubbles with LA DOLCE VITA Coffee Soda. Crafted with rich, aromatic coffee and a touch of natural sweetness, this sparkling beverage offers a unique balance of robust flavor and crisp effervescence. Perfect as a midday pick-me-up or a sophisticated mixer, it's gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and made with only natural ingredients. Elevate your coffee experience with this innovative twist on Italian tradition. Sip, refresh, and enjoy la dolce vita in every effervescent drop!

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Limonata (Lemonade)
dishes.description: LA DOLCE VITA Italian Limonata: Indulge in the crisp, zesty flavors of Italy with this authentic Italian lemon soda. Made with sun-ripened Italian lemons, LA DOLCE VITA Limonata offers a delightful balance of tart citrus and refreshing sweetness. Perfectly sparkling, it's a versatile drink to enjoy on its own or as a complement to your favorite cocktails. Gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and crafted without artificial ingredients, this premium beverage brings a taste of la dolce vita to every occasion. Refresh your day with the essence of the Mediterranean!

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Spritz
dishes.description: LA DOLCE VITA Spritz Non-Alcoholic: Embrace the spirit of Italy with this non-alcoholic twist on the classic spritz. LA DOLCE VITA Spritz delivers a harmonious blend of zesty citrus, herbal notes, and effervescent bubbles, perfectly capturing the refreshing taste of an Italian aperitivo—without the alcohol. Ideal for any time of day, this guilt-free beverage is gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and crafted with natural ingredients. Enjoy it over ice with a slice of orange for a taste of la dolce vita, wherever you are. Perfect for celebrations, gatherings, or a relaxing moment of indulgence!

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Chinotto
dishes.description:
The soft drink flavored with Chinotto di Calabria is a refreshing and aromatic option which expertly combines the characteristic taste of chinotto. Fruit of an infusion of chinotto, a bitter citrus fruit typical of the Calabrian region, this drink enchants the senses with its tasting complexity. 

NON-ALCOHOLIC

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Italian Cola
dishes.description:
Unique and satisfying experience: this Cola drink captures the bold and vibrant soul of its traditional roots. With an exclusive blend of selected ingredients, it offers a rich and enveloping taste, with notes of spices and a balanced sweetness. 

NON-ALCOHOLIC

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Aranciata Rossa
dishes.description:
LA DOLCE VITA Blood Orange Soda: Experience the vibrant essence of Italy with every sip of this refreshing blood orange soda. Crafted with real Italian blood oranges, this sparkling beverage delivers a perfect balance of tangy citrus flavor and natural sweetness. Ideal for enjoying on its own or as a mixer, LA DOLCE VITA Blood Orange Soda brings a burst of Mediterranean sunshine to your day. Gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and made without artificial flavors, it's the perfect choice for those who crave authentic, high-quality refreshment. Taste the dolce vita lifestyle in every can!

NON-ALCOHOLIC

dishes.name: La Dolce Vita Bergamot Soda
dishes.description:
LA DOLCE VITA Bergamot Soda: Savor the elegant and aromatic taste of Italy with this premium Bergamot soda. Infused with the essence of bergamot citrus, renowned for its fragrant and slightly floral notes, this sparkling beverage delivers a refreshing blend of tangy and sweet flavors. Perfect for enjoying on its own or as a refined mixer, LA DOLCE VITA Bergamot Soda brings a sophisticated touch to any occasion. Naturally gluten-free, vegan-friendly, and free from artificial additives, it's a delightful way to experience the true taste of Italian tradition. Refresh your palate with a sip of elegance!

NON-ALCOHOLIC
